question: The part of the Himalayas lying between Satluj and Kali rivers is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumaun Himalayas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Kumaun Himalayas stretch between the Satluj and Kali rivers.
 
• This region includes major parts of Uttarakhand, particularly the districts of Nainital, Almora, and Pithoragarh.
 
• It is known for its scenic beauty, including picturesque hill stations such as Nainital and Almora.
 
• The Kumaun Himalayas are rich in biodiversity and have several protected areas, including the famous Jim Corbett National Park.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Purvanchal**

 
 
• The Purvanchal Himalayas extend from the east of Nepal across northern parts of West Bengal, Sikkim, Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, and the eastern states of India.
 
• This range includes the Patkai, Naga, Mizo, and Manipur hills.
 
• They are characterized by their rugged terrain and dense forests.
 
 
 
• **Nepal Himalayas**
 
 
• The Nepal Himalayas lie between the Kali river (west) and the Tista river (east).
 
• It includes some of the world's highest peaks like Mount Everest, Kanchenjunga, and Lhotse.
 
• This region is known for its significant cultural and religious heritage, as well as trekking and mountaineering opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Assam Himalayas**
 
 
• The Assam Himalayas extend from the eastern border of Bhutan to the bend of the Brahmaputra river in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• This region is characterized by its high rainfall and dense tropical forests.
 
• It is known for its rich biodiversity, including numerous endemic species of flora and fauna.
